function typeOfAny<T>(x: T[never]): T[never] { return x; }
function explicitAny<T extends any>(x: T[never]): never { return x; }
function explicitUnknown<T extends unknown>(x: T[never]): never { return x; }
function explicitObject<T extends object>(x: T[never]): never { return x; }
function explicitEmpty<T extends {}>(x: T[never]): never { return x; }
function explicitNamed<T extends {a: 1}>(x: T[never]): never { return x; }
function explicitIndexed<T extends {[k:string]: number}>(x: T[never]): number { return x; }
function explicitChain<T extends U, U extends {a: 1}>(x: T[never]): never { return x; }
function inter<T>(x: (T & {a: 1})[never]): never { return x; }
function constrainedUnion<T extends {a: 1}>(x: (T | {b: 1})[never]): never { return x; }
function constrainedKey<T extends {a: 1}, K extends never>(x: T[K]): never { return x; }
function value<T>(x: T, k: never): never { return x[k]; }
function constrainedValue<T extends {a: 1}>(x: T, k: never): never { return x[k]; }
console.log(typeOfAny<any>(123));
